mechanism: Foscarnet can cause electrolyte disturbances (hypocalcemia, hypomagnesemia) and renal impairment which may affect liraglutide efficacy and increase hypoglycemia risk; liraglutide delays gastric emptying which may affect foscarnet absorption.
action: Monitor blood glucose closely, renal function, and electrolytes during concurrent use; adjust liraglutide dosing if renal function declines; ensure adequate hydration with foscarnet therapy.
